commands.name: image-analyse
commands.description: Analyse a character image down to the smallest mole and diff it against a canon — per-feature spec, OCR tattoo text, severity-ranked drift report.

commands.name: image
commands.description: Character-image fidelity orchestrator — analyse, create, and verify a character image against its canon. Routes to analyse, create, verify.

commands.name: image-create
commands.description: Generate a character image to spec — assemble a max-fidelity, anchors-first prompt from a Canon Spec; governance- and provider-gated, dry-run by default.

commands.name: image-verify
commands.description: Verify a candidate render against its canon — run the analyser in loop mode, emit the gate verdict + remaining diff, halt-and-surface on non-pass.

commands.name: video
commands.description: Video-creation orchestrator — Hollywood-level AI video pipeline. Routes to from-script, from-song, scene, storyboard, stitch.

commands.name: video-from-script
commands.description: Drive a script end-to-end through the AI video pipeline — scenes → blueprint → image → operator pick → motion → video → stitch. Preview default; --mode commit spends behind the cost gate.

commands.name: video-from-song
commands.description: Music-video from a song + reference images — accept or derive a timed scene script, optional character-lock, render, stitch, mux song as master track. Preview default; --mode commit gates the spend.

commands.name: video-scene
commands.description: Render a single scene from a one-line idea — scene-expander → blueprint → image → operator pick → motion → video. Preview mode default (no spend); --mode commit renders live behind the cost gate.

commands.name: video-stitch
commands.description: Re-stitch existing clips in `<project>/scenes/*/` after operator edits — no re-render. ffmpeg concat driven by manifest.json.

commands.name: video-storyboard
commands.description: Image-only storyboard — script → scenes → blueprint → image render → contact-sheet PNG via ffmpeg montage. No video calls.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analysis orchestrator — confidence-weighted suggester that routes to postmortem, premortem, decision-review, near-miss, incident, reference-repo, or inbox-artifact analysis.

commands.name: analyze-conformance
commands.description: Audit recent local sessions for rule violations — deterministic scan plus subagent passes over the transcripts, root-cause each class, and emit a roadmap that mechanises what is mechanisable.

commands.name: analyze-decision
commands.description: Audit a past architectural decision — restate what was chosen and why, compare original assumptions against reality now, produce a verdict (still valid / needs amendment / superseded).

commands.name: analyze-inbox
commands.description: Analyze a dropped inbox artifact (review, prompt, spec, transcript) against the current tree, verify every claim it makes, map what survives onto this suite's artefact types, emit a roadmap each.

commands.name: analyze-incident
commands.description: Full incident flow — incident-commander coordination, then RCA via root-cause-frameworks, then a blame-free write-up via blameless-post-mortem, ending with an incident-learnings candidate.

commands.name: analyze-near-miss
commands.description: Blame-free near-miss analysis — same post-mortem flow as analyze:postmortem but framed around a close call that did not result in a production incident.

commands.name: analyze-postmortem
commands.description: Blame-free post-mortem after a resolved incident — consume the incident-commander skeleton, derive root cause, write corrective actions, draft an incident-learnings memory candidate.

commands.name: analyze-premortem
commands.description: Forward-looking imagined-failure analysis before committing to a heavy or irreversible plan — enumerate failure stories, score each mode, derive early-warning signals and guardrails.

commands.name: analyze-reference-repo
commands.description: Analyze an external reference repository (competitor, inspiration, peer) and produce a structured comparison + adoption plan for this project.

commands.name: brand
commands.description: Brand-as-UX orchestrator — strategy, identity, tokens, review, voice. Routes to the brand-grounding skills that constrain the design layer.

commands.name: brand-identity
commands.description: Define the brand identity — logo direction, colour story, type story, imagery direction — and the token constraints downstream generation consumes.

commands.name: brand-review
commands.description: Audit emitted UI, copy, and assets against the active brand tokens and voice profile — flag any value not traceable to a brand token or voice rule.

commands.name: brand-strategy
commands.description: Define brand positioning, archetype, voice, tone, and messaging over the brand-grounding corpus — the strategy that bounds identity and UI.

commands.name: brand-tokens
commands.description: Derive a DTCG .tokens.json source of truth from brand decisions, then emit CSS vars + Tailwind via the no-Node token generator.

commands.name: brand-voice
commands.description: Define the brand voice-and-tone profile — register, do/don't lexicon, and tone shifts by context — the profile the brand-consistency gate checks copy against.

commands.name: bug
commands.description: Bug orchestrator — routes to investigate (root cause) and fix (plan + implement)

commands.name: bug-fix
commands.description: Plan and implement a bug fix — based on investigation, with quality checks and test verification

commands.name: bug-investigate
commands.description: Investigate a bug — auto-detect ticket from branch, gather Jira/Sentry/description context, trace root cause

commands.name: design-system-capture
commands.description: Inventory this repo's own components and tokens and emit them in the design-system.json shape, so the import path is identical to an external extraction.

commands.name: design-system
commands.description: Design-system onramp — generate one from the corpus, import an extractor's output, or capture the current repo's. Three doors onto machinery that already ships.

commands.name: design-system-generate
commands.description: Ground a design system in the curated design corpus from a product or industry brief, then optionally persist it as MASTER.md or seed DESIGN.md.

commands.name: design-system-import
commands.description: Run an extraction tool's output through the three-lane adapter into the design-system.json contract, then hand it to the per-field confirmation import.

commands.name: feature
commands.description: Feature orchestrator — routes to explore, plan, refactor, roadmap, dev

commands.name: feature-dev
commands.description: Full 7-phase feature development workflow for complex features.

commands.name: feature-explore
commands.description: Brainstorm and explore a feature idea before committing to a full plan

commands.name: feature-plan
commands.description: Interactively plan a feature — research, discuss, and create a structured feature document

commands.name: feature-refactor
commands.description: Refine and update an existing feature plan through interactive discussion

commands.name: feature-roadmap
commands.description: Generate implementation roadmap(s) from a feature plan and link them

commands.name: fix-ci
commands.description: Fetch CI errors from GitHub Actions and fix them

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Fix orchestrator — routes to ci, references, portability, seeder, pr-comments, comments, quality

commands.name: fix-comments
commands.description: Review the code comments touched by the current branch and simplify, shorten, or remove each one

commands.name: fix-portability
commands.description: Find and fix project-specific references in shared .augment/ package files

commands.name: fix-pr-comments
commands.description: Fix, commit+push, reply to, then resolve all open review comments (bots + human reviewers) on a GitHub PR

commands.name: fix-pr-comments-loop
commands.description: Loop /fix pr-comments on a PR — fix, commit+push, re-request Copilot review, repeat until Copilot has no new comments

commands.name: fix-quality
commands.description: Run quality pipeline (PHP and/or JS/TS) and fix all errors — auto-detects language from changed files

commands.name: fix-refs
commands.description: Find and fix broken cross-references in .augment/ and agents/ files

commands.name: fix-route
commands.description: Classify a vaguely-described problem and dispatch to the right fix sub-command (or name the specialist skill when it is not a fix task)

commands.name: fix-seeder
commands.description: Scan seeder data files for broken foreign key references — find constants used without getReference() and fix them

commands.name: implement-ticket
commands.description: Drive a ticket end-to-end through refine → memory → analyze → plan → implement → test → verify → report — Option-A loop over the `work_engine` engine, block-on-ambiguity, no auto-git.

commands.name: judge
commands.description: Judge orchestrator — routes to solo, steps, on-diff

commands.name: judge-on-diff
commands.description: Run a single change through an implementer→judge loop with a two-revision ceiling, then hand back to the user

commands.name: judge-solo
commands.description: Run a standalone judge on an existing diff or code change — no implementer, no revision loop, verdict only

commands.name: judge-steps
commands.description: Execute an ordered plan step by step with a judge gate between steps — stops on first failed verdict

commands.name: mission-upgrade
commands.description: Gated Laravel major-version upgrade mission — provisional branch, breaking-change catalog, size-tier surfaced, git-as-rollback. Never auto-commits or auto-PRs.

commands.name: module
commands.description: Module orchestrator — routes to create, explore

commands.name: module-create
commands.description: Create a new module from .module-template with interactive setup

commands.name: module-explore
commands.description: Explore a module — load its structure, docs, and context into the current conversation

commands.name: prepare-for-review
commands.description: Prepare a PR branch for local review — updates main and merges the full branch chain so the branch is up to date

commands.name: project-analyze
commands.description: Full project analysis — detect stack, inventory modules, audit docs, create missing contexts

commands.name: project
commands.description: Project orchestrator — routes to analyze (full audit) and health (read-only status check)

commands.name: project-health
commands.description: Quick project health check — show status of docs, modules, contexts, and roadmaps without creating anything

commands.name: review-changes
commands.description: Self-review local changes before creating a PR — dispatches to five specialized judges (bug, security, tests, quality, architecture) and consolidates verdicts

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review orchestrator — routes to changes (five-judge self-review of the local diff) and routing (compute reviewer roles + historical bug patterns)

commands.name: review-routing
commands.description: Compute reviewer roles and matched historical bug patterns for the current diff, using project-local ownership-map.yml and historical-bug-patterns.yml

commands.name: security-audit-config
commands.description: Audit an assembled agent config (CLAUDE.md, .cursor/rules, settings, MCP, hooks, skills) for prompt-injection / supply-chain risk — A–F score per category, mapped to OWASP Agentic Top 10

commands.name: tdd
commands.description: TDD orchestrator — routes to red (failing test), green (minimum code), refactor (clean while green)

commands.name: tdd-green
commands.description: TDD green phase — write the minimum production code to make the failing test pass; no test edits

commands.name: tdd-red
commands.description: TDD red phase — enumerate cases, write ONE failing test, watch it fail at an assertion (not an import error)

commands.name: tdd-refactor
commands.description: TDD refactor phase — clean up (rename, deduplicate) while keeping the test green

commands.name: tests
commands.description: Tests orchestrator — routes to create, execute, e2e-plan, e2e-heal

commands.name: tests-create
commands.description: Write meaningful tests for the current branch — stack-adaptive (pest / phpunit / vitest / jest / pytest / …)

commands.name: tests-e2e-heal
commands.description: Find, debug, and fix failing Playwright E2E tests

commands.name: tests-e2e-plan
commands.description: Explore the application and create a structured E2E test plan in Markdown

commands.name: tests-execute
commands.description: Run the project's test suite — stack-adaptive (pest / phpunit / vitest / jest / pytest / …)

commands.name: threat-model
commands.description: Run a pre-implementation threat model on a proposed change — enumerates abuse cases, trust boundaries, and authorization gaps before the first line of code is written

commands.name: update-form-request-messages
commands.description: Sync the messages() method of a FormRequest class — add missing entries, link them to language keys, and clean up stale ones.

commands.name: work
commands.description: Drive a free-form prompt end-to-end through refine → score → plan → implement → test → verify → report — Option-A loop over the `work_engine` engine, confidence-band gated, no auto-git.

commands.name: worktree-cleanup
commands.description: Safe worktree removal gate — refuses while the branch holds commits on no other ref; never force-deletes

commands.name: worktree
commands.description: Worktree orchestrator — routes to create, status, verify, cleanup

commands.name: worktree-create
commands.description: Create a governed worktree and write its scope-lock note — propose-once branch naming, host-native primitive preferred

commands.name: worktree-status
commands.description: List active worktrees — ownership (scope lock), dirty state, ahead/behind, merge-readiness incl. verification evidence

commands.name: worktree-verify
commands.description: Run the scoped verification for a worktree's declared change — narrow probes matched to the diff, never the full CI pipeline

commands.name: prediction-pool
commands.description: Fill a prediction pool (kicktipp, football/basketball WM): optimize expected points under the rules, enter tips via Playwright. Triggers 'Tippspiel', 'kicktipp', 'predict the pool'.

commands.name: git-commit
commands.description: Stage and commit all uncommitted changes — splits into logical commits following Conventional Commits

commands.name: git-commit-in-chunks
commands.description: Stage and commit all uncommitted changes in logical chunks WITHOUT confirmation — sibling of /commit for autonomous flows

commands.name: git-pr-create
commands.description: Create a GitHub PR with structured description from Jira ticket and code changes

commands.name: git-pr-create-description-only
commands.description: Generate a PR description as a copyable markdown block — used standalone or by create-pr

commands.name: ghostwriter
commands.description: Ghostwriter cluster — fetch, write, list, show, and delete public-figure voice profiles (the third voice primitive alongside personas/ and .agent-user.md).

commands.name: ghostwriter-delete
commands.description: Hard-delete a ghostwriter profile at agents/reference/ghostwriter/<slug>.md after a two-step confirmation. No backup, no soft delete — the file is gone after acceptance.

commands.name: ghostwriter-fetch
commands.description: Build or refresh a public-figure voice profile under agents/reference/ghostwriter/ from a URL or bare name; runs the public-figure attestation gate; delegates web-fetch/web-search to host.

commands.name: ghostwriter-list
commands.description: List captured ghostwriter profiles under agents/reference/ghostwriter/ as a numbered table with confidence, last-fetched, and stale-warning flags. Read-only.

commands.name: ghostwriter-show
commands.description: Render a single ghostwriter profile in full — identity, style fingerprint, voice samples, taboos, source URLs. Read-only.

commands.name: ghostwriter-write
commands.description: Draft a markdown post in the voice of a captured public-figure ghostwriter profile; appends the mandatory non-removable disclosure footer.

commands.name: humanize
commands.description: Remove AI-writing tells from pasted text or a file — runs the humanizer skill's draft→audit→final loop and prints the rewrite plus a detector summary.

commands.name: post-as
commands.description: Consumer-facing write entry points — :me drafts in the maintainer's own voice from .agent-user.md (no disclosure); :ghostwriter is a thin alias for /ghostwriter:write (mandatory disclosure footer).

commands.name: post-as-ghostwriter
commands.description: Thin alias for /ghostwriter:write — drafts a copyable markdown post in a captured public-figure voice with the mandatory non-removable disclosure footer.

commands.name: post-as-me
commands.description: Draft a copyable markdown post in the maintainer's own voice (style source = .agent-user.md.voice_sample). No disclosure footer — the user is the author.

commands.name: agent-handoff
commands.description: Pick a recent session, generate a handoff from its transcript, and seed a fresh session with it — or summarize the live conversation for copy-paste.

commands.name: agent-status
commands.description: Show current conversation stats — message count, token costs, task progress, next freshness check.

commands.name: agents-audit
commands.description: Audit agent infrastructure — token overhead, rule triggers, AGENTS.md health, Capability-over-Structure adherence, stale references. Read-only, suggest-only, never auto-apply.

commands.name: agents
commands.description: Agent-layer orchestrator — routes to init, optimize, audit. Covers AGENTS.md and its multi-tool stubs (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, copilot-instructions.md, .cursorrules).

commands.name: agents-init
commands.description: Initialize the agent layer for a consumer project — creates AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md from package templates, auto-detects stack, never leaks other projects' identifiers.

commands.name: agents-optimize
commands.description: Refactor AGENTS.md to the Thin-Root contract (caps, pointer ratio, capability bullets, emergency-triage) and propagate to tool stubs. Suggest only, never auto-apply.

commands.name: agents-user-accept
commands.description: Apply a buffered observation to .agent-user.md or the global profile.md after explicit user confirmation; bumps last_updated and drops the applied observations from the buffer.

commands.name: agents-user
commands.description: User-persona file (.agent-user.md) — interview, render, and maintain who the user is and how they want to be addressed.

commands.name: agents-user-delete
commands.description: Delete one buffered global observation, purge every observation attributed to a project, or revoke a field from the global profile.md — each writes an append-only tombstone before deleting.

commands.name: agents-user-init
commands.description: Interactive interview that creates the project-root .agent-user.md from the locked v1 schema (name, language, role, style, voice_sample).

commands.name: agents-user-review
commands.description: List buffered observations from the project-local and global observation buffers with numbered options to inspect or accept individually.

commands.name: agents-user-show
commands.description: Read-only render of the effective (merged) user profile — global profile.md plus project .agent-user.md. --audit renders the global layer raw for delete/revoke decisions.

commands.name: agents-user-update
commands.description: Open .agent-user.md in the user's IDE for manual edit; validates schema and 100-line cap on save.

commands.name: analytics
commands.description: Analytics orchestrator — routes to show, prune. Local-only workspace event log under `~/.event4u/agent-config/workspace/analytics/`.

commands.name: analytics-prune
commands.description: Drop events older than the 90-day retention window from the local analytics log. Atomic and idempotent.

commands.name: analytics-show
commands.description: Render top prompts, launcher → completion rate per role, average session length, and knowledge-source usage from the local analytics log.

commands.name: challenge-me
commands.description: Challenge-me orchestrator — routes to vision, with-docs

commands.name: challenge-me-vision
commands.description: Stress-test a plan or idea by one-question-at-a-time interview until 95% confidence — emits a copyable Markdown vision pitch for tickets, roadmaps, or fresh-chat handoff.

commands.name: challenge-me-with-docs
commands.description: Doc-aware /challenge-me — 95%-confidence interview with session glossary vs CONTEXT.md, load-bearing claim-vs-code verification, optional CONTEXT.md patch + ADR candidates in the pitch.

commands.name: chat-history
commands.description: Chat-history orchestrator — routes to import (selective cross-session resume). Mining moved to /memory mine-session; raw-log inspection uses the host's native transcript view.

commands.name: chat-history-import
commands.description: Surface prior chat-history sessions as a numbered table, let the user pick one, read it silently, and emit a short summary plus a resume offer — selective, user-driven cross-session import

commands.name: check-current-md
commands.description: Check the open .md file (or a passed path) for German outside DE:/EN: anchor blocks — umlauts, function words, untranslated quotes. Reports and offers fixes.

commands.name: condense
commands.description: Condense .md files from src/ into telegraph format and write to dist/agent-src/

commands.name: context
commands.description: Context orchestrator — routes to create, refactor

commands.name: context-create
commands.description: Analyze a codebase area and create a structured context document

commands.name: context-refactor
commands.description: Analyze, update, and extend an existing context document

commands.name: contribution-precheck
commands.description: Contributor self-service precheck: run the PR-relevant lint subset (skill linter, originality gate, frontmatter schema) on changed files locally — a verdict with fix hints before opening a PR.

commands.name: cost
commands.description: Cost orchestrator — routes to report (session token cost + budget ladder) and profile (change the rule_loading_tier)

commands.name: cost-profile
commands.description: Change the rule_loading_tier in .agent-settings.yml — shows each profile's meaning and applies the selection

commands.name: cost-report
commands.description: Capture token cost from the active Claude Code session, append to the local sessions store, and surface the 50/75/90/100% budget alert ladder with cost-profile suggestions.

commands.name: council-analysis
commands.description: Run the council on a local analysis output (project-analyze, audit script, codebase scan) — critiques the analysis itself for dedup, evidence quality, and roadmap-readiness.

commands.name: council
commands.description: Council orchestrator — routes to default, pr, design, optimize, analysis, debate

commands.name: council-debate
commands.description: Multi-round council debate with progressive cost disclosure — each member produces a position, then rebuts the strongest opposing position in subsequent rounds. User confirms spend between rounds.

commands.name: council-default
commands.description: Default council lens — neutral framing, redacted context, advisory output only. Run `/council default <input>` for prompt/roadmap/diff/files; the cluster shows a menu when invoked bare.

commands.name: council-design
commands.description: Run the council on a design document, ADR, or architecture proposal — surfaces hidden coupling, missing rollback, and sequencing risk before commitment.

commands.name: council-optimize
commands.description: Run the council on an optimization target — perf hot path, memory pattern, query, or an /optimize-* output — for ranked, evidence-based suggestions instead of generic advice.

commands.name: council-pr
commands.description: Pull a GitHub PR via gh CLI and run the council on the diff with a PR-specific neutrality preamble — read-only by default; comment posting is opt-in.

commands.name: explain-run
commands.description: Read-only 'why did that happen' run report — resolved rule set, rules fired, artefact engagement, subagent dispatches, hook/loop/freshness state — even when the user just says 'explain the last run'.

commands.name: grill-me
commands.description: Alias for /challenge-me — interactive grill-style interview that sharpens a fuzzy plan/idea into a copyable Markdown pitch

commands.name: memory-add
commands.description: Interactively add a validated entry to an engineering-memory file (domain-invariants, incident-learnings, product-rules, ownership, historical-patterns)

commands.name: memory
commands.description: Memory orchestrator — routes to add, load, mine-session, promote, propose

commands.name: memory-learn-low-impact
commands.description: Preview validated low-impact entries that would be upstreamed to the package seed (default `--preview`); `--apply` opens a draft PR via `upstream-contribute` after re-redaction.

commands.name: memory-load
commands.description: Load ALL curated entries of a given memory type into the current context — opt-in full load for deep analysis, never auto-triggered

commands.name: memory-mine-session
commands.description: Mine a session (cross-host chat-history log) for memory signals and/or rule/skill proposal seeds via --mode=[signals|proposals|both]. Preview-default, opt-in. Folds in /chat-history learn.

commands.name: memory-promote
commands.description: Promote an intake signal (or provisional proposal) into a curated memory entry — opens a PR and runs the admission gate.

commands.name: memory-propose
commands.description: Append a provisional memory signal to the intake stream — the universal fallback for any producer (human or agent) to record a finding without committing to a curated entry.

commands.name: mode
commands.description: Set the active role mode — prints the contract, lists default skills, and refuses work outside the contract (see role-contracts)

commands.name: optimize-agents-dir
commands.description: Manage the agents/ directory — scaffold, folder-audit, fix. Single command with three modes (--scaffold / --audit / --fix); default = interactive wizard.

commands.name: optimize-augmentignore
commands.description: Creates or updates .augmentignore based on the project's actual tech stack, large files, generated artifacts, and irrelevant agent skills/rules.

commands.name: optimize
commands.description: Optimize orchestrator — routes to skills, agents-dir, augmentignore, rtk-filters, project (project-wide sweep), prompt (AI-prompt polish), deep (autonomous deep-refactoring loop)

commands.name: optimize-deep
commands.description: Autonomous deep-refactoring loop — subagent analysis, verified findings, council, central + sub-roadmaps, PR, then N refinement loops (default 3). E.g. 'run a deep optimization pass'.

commands.name: optimize-project
commands.description: Project-wide optimization sweep — inventory roadmaps, ADRs, agent folders (incl. modules), challenge stale decisions with the user in the loop, emit new roadmap(s). E.g. 'optimize this project'.

commands.name: optimize-prompt
commands.description: Optimize a raw prompt for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another AI via the 4-D methodology — BASIC vs DETAIL auto-detect, one clarifying question per turn, returns the polished prompt.

commands.name: optimize-rtk
commands.description: Create or optimize project-local rtk filters based on the actual toolchain

commands.name: optimize-skills
commands.description: Audits skills — measures baseline, finds duplicates/merge candidates, runs linter. Suggest only, never auto-apply.

commands.name: orchestrate
commands.description: Run a YAML pipeline defined under `.agent-config/orchestrations/` — chains personas / skills / commands / sub-agents per the orchestration-dsl-v1 contract

commands.name: override
commands.description: Override orchestrator — routes to create, manage

commands.name: override-create
commands.description: Creates a project-level override for a shared skill, rule, or command.

commands.name: override-manage
commands.description: Reviews, updates, and refactors existing project-level overrides.

commands.name: package
commands.description: Package orchestrator — routes to test (verify the package install) and reset (restore installed state)

commands.name: package-reset
commands.description: /package-reset

commands.name: package-test
commands.description: /package-test

commands.name: profile-activate
commands.description: Activate a session profile — surface only the named profile/pack closure plus core artefacts, no persistence

commands.name: profile
commands.description: Session-profile orchestrator — activate / deactivate / show the active packs for this session (recommendation-bias surface filter, no persistence)

commands.name: profile-deactivate
commands.description: Deactivate the session profile — clear the overlay (or drop named packs) so the full surface returns

commands.name: profile-show
commands.description: Show the active session profile — active packs and surfaced/hidden command+skill counts (observability surface)

commands.name: rule-compliance-audit
commands.description: Audit rule trigger quality, simulate activation, detect overlaps, find never-activating rules, and replay the router matcher over recent prompts (route:audit)

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Single-skill orchestrator — routes to preview. Non-destructive "what will this skill do?" before you run it.

commands.name: skill-preview
commands.description: Non-destructive preview of a skill — its declared steps, execution type, allowed tools, and file/command targets — before you run it. Read-only, no execution.

commands.name: skills
commands.description: Skill discovery orchestrator — routes to discover. Local, explained skill recommendations over the catalog + role shortlists + optional local analytics.

commands.name: skills-discover
commands.description: Recommend skills for a role — ranked by four explained classes (most-useful-for-role, related-to-current-task, recently-adopted, popular-in-role). Local-only; every result carries a why.

commands.name: sync-agent-settings
commands.description: Sync `.agent-settings.yml` against the current template + profile — adds new sections/keys, preserves user values, shows a diff before writing

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Sync orchestrator — routes to agent-settings (template sync) and gitignore (managed block sync, plus legacy-cleanup fix)

commands.name: sync-gitignore
commands.description: Sync the `event4u/agent-config` block in the consumer project's .gitignore — adds missing entries, preserves user-added lines, shows a diff before writing

commands.name: sync-gitignore-fix
commands.description: Scrub legacy pre-`/agents/` patterns from the consumer's .gitignore (inside or outside the managed block) and re-sync the canonical entries

commands.name: team-adversarial
commands.description: Thin wrapper — adversarial cross-model review on a named focus via the official plugin (/codex:adversarial-review). Escalation rung above the single-model adversarial-review skill.

commands.name: team
commands.description: Team orchestrator — governed cross-model access layer (a second strong model reviews the real diff; read-only multi-host fallback); routes to review, adversarial, delegate, status

commands.name: team-delegate
commands.description: Thin wrapper — hand a task to the second model as a native worker via the official plugin (/codex:rescue). The only write-access wrapper; double-gated behind ai_team.allow_delegate.

commands.name: team-review
commands.description: Thin wrapper — cross-model review of the current diff via the official plugin (/codex:review). Gated on /team availability (codex CLI + auth); fails closed when the plugin is absent.

commands.name: team-status
commands.description: Thin wrapper — plugin job status via /codex:status plus a quota block (shared openai counter vs team + council ceilings). Gated on codex CLI/auth availability; fails closed without the plugin.

commands.name: team-knowledge-bootstrap
commands.description: One-shot deterministic seed for a fresh project's knowledge layer — stages template pages from real config/directory detection, never LLM-invented claims. Review-then-commit.

commands.name: team-knowledge
commands.description: Team-knowledge orchestrator — routes to consolidate and bootstrap

commands.name: team-knowledge-consolidate
commands.description: Review pending typed knowledge-observation events and file them into agents/knowledge/ pages as a human-reviewed batch — never writes without approval.

commands.name: upstream-contribute
commands.description: Contribute a learning, skill, rule, or fix from a consumer project back to the shared agent-config package

commands.name: estimate-ticket
commands.description: Estimate a Jira/Linear ticket before sprint planning — size + risk + split recommendation + uncertainty, sibling to /refine-ticket, ends with a close-prompt

commands.name: jira-ticket
commands.description: Read Jira ticket from branch name, analyze linked Sentry issues, implement feature or fix bug

commands.name: refine-ticket
commands.description: Refine a Jira/Linear ticket before planning — rewritten ticket + Top-5 risks + persona voices, orchestrates validate-feature-fit and threat-modeling, ends with a close-prompt

commands.name: roadmap-ai-council
commands.description: Challenge a roadmap with the AI council (deep tier) and refactor from convergence findings. Wraps `/council default` pinned to `--input-mode roadmap --depth deep`; patches surface as numbered options.

commands.name: roadmap
commands.description: Roadmap orchestrator — routes to create (authoring), process-step / process-phase / process-full (autonomous execution), and next (pick a roadmap and ship it).

commands.name: roadmap-create
commands.description: Interactively create a new roadmap file in agents/roadmaps/

commands.name: roadmap-materialize
commands.description: Materialise a roadmap into a self-contained, importable ticket bundle under agents/tickets/

commands.name: roadmap-next
commands.description: Pick the next executable roadmap and carry it to a reviewable PR — live remote screen, five-disqualifier feasibility pass, council on the pick, process-full, chunked commits, PR, CI fix.

commands.name: roadmap-process-full
commands.description: Autonomously process every open step across every phase of a roadmap until the file is fully closed. Largest execution scope of the /roadmap cluster — runs continuously across phase boundaries.

commands.name: roadmap-process-phase
commands.description: Autonomously process every open step in the next or current phase of a roadmap, then stop. Default execution scope of the /roadmap cluster.

commands.name: roadmap-process-step
commands.description: Autonomously process the single next open step of a roadmap and stop. Smallest execution scope of the /roadmap cluster — one step in, one step out.

commands.name: knowledge
commands.description: Knowledge orchestrator — routes to ingest, list, forget. Local-only file ingestion into the agent memory namespace.

commands.name: knowledge-cross-repo
commands.description: Targeted, read-only retrieval over opted-in linked-project siblings (ADR-032 Option A). Pulls a shared type / API contract / config without bulk-including sibling files.

commands.name: knowledge-forget
commands.description: Drop a knowledge ingest from `agents/memory/knowledge/` by id prefix. Atomic, no partial state. Pinning protects from LRU eviction, not from explicit forget — pinned ingests are dropped the same.

commands.name: knowledge-ingest
commands.description: Walk a local path (folder, .zip, single file), redact PII + secrets, chunk to 2 KB markdown, and persist into the agent memory namespace under `knowledge/<ingest-id>/`.

commands.name: knowledge-list
commands.description: List existing knowledge ingests in `agents/memory/knowledge/` (table or JSON); pin / unpin by id prefix to control LRU eviction.

commands.name: research
commands.description: Preliminary research scaffolder — pick objects, define fields, emit `outline.yaml` + `fields.yaml` for downstream deep research. Use for surveys, benchmarks, tech selection, competitive scans.

commands.name: research-deep
commands.description: Read `outline.yaml`, research each item in batches, write per-item JSON validated against the project-local research-schema. No Python runtime, no `~/.claude/` paths.

commands.name: research-report
commands.description: Summarise per-item JSON results from `/research:deep` into `report.md`. Agent renders directly + emits an optional `jq` template for deterministic regeneration. No Python runtime.

overlap_pairs.a_description: Autonomously process every open step in the next or current phase of a roadmap, then stop. Default execution scope of the /roadmap cluster.
overlap_pairs.b_description: Autonomously process the single next open step of a roadmap and stop. Smallest execution scope of the /roadmap cluster — one step in, one step out.

overlap_pairs.a_description: Drive a ticket end-to-end through refine → memory → analyze → plan → implement → test → verify → report — Option-A loop over the `work_engine` engine, block-on-ambiguity, no auto-git.
overlap_pairs.b_description: Drive a free-form prompt end-to-end through refine → score → plan → implement → test → verify → report — Option-A loop over the `work_engine` engine, confidence-band gated, no auto-git.

overlap_pairs.a_description: Draft a markdown post in the voice of a captured public-figure ghostwriter profile; appends the mandatory non-removable disclosure footer.
overlap_pairs.b_description: Thin alias for /ghostwriter:write — drafts a copyable markdown post in a captured public-figure voice with the mandatory non-removable disclosure footer.

overlap_pairs.a_description: Autonomously process every open step across every phase of a roadmap until the file is fully closed. Largest execution scope of the /roadmap cluster — runs continuously across phase boundaries.
overlap_pairs.b_description: Autonomously process every open step in the next or current phase of a roadmap, then stop. Default execution scope of the /roadmap cluster.

overlap_pairs.a_description: Write meaningful tests for the current branch — stack-adaptive (pest / phpunit / vitest / jest / pytest / …)
overlap_pairs.b_description: Run the project's test suite — stack-adaptive (pest / phpunit / vitest / jest / pytest / …)

overlap_pairs.a_description: Consumer-facing write entry points — :me drafts in the maintainer's own voice from .agent-user.md (no disclosure); :ghostwriter is a thin alias for /ghostwriter:write (mandatory disclosure footer).
overlap_pairs.b_description: Thin alias for /ghostwriter:write — drafts a copyable markdown post in a captured public-figure voice with the mandatory non-removable disclosure footer.

overlap_pairs.a_description: Thin wrapper — cross-model review of the current diff via the official plugin (/codex:review). Gated on /team availability (codex CLI + auth); fails closed when the plugin is absent.
overlap_pairs.b_description: Thin wrapper — plugin job status via /codex:status plus a quota block (shared openai counter vs team + council ceilings). Gated on codex CLI/auth availability; fails closed without the plugin.
